Two PRDs are queued on Epic `psess-msareb8c-13` ("Browser Broken"):

**PRD 907** — Real popup window + Chrome UA for OAuth identity-provider flows (`~20 min`)
Root cause fix: `setWindowOpenHandler` in `src/main/browserView.cjs:191-196` currently *always* denies popups and fires a dead IPC event (`browser:open-tab-request`, no renderer listener). That's why Google's GIS popup — which needs a real `window.opener` to hand credentials back to — dead-ends at `accounts.google.com/gsi/transform`. Fix: allowlist identity-provider hostnames (Google first, structured to extend), return `overrideBrowserWindowOptions` so Electron spawns a genuine child window for those, and set a real Chrome UA (no UA is set anywhere today, so the view ships as `Electron/x.y.z`, which Google's OAuth endpoint can flag).

**PRD 908** — Wire the dead `browser:open-tab-request` listener for non-auth popups + write `session-manager-operations/browser/README.md` (`~18 min`, depends on 907)
Closes the second gap: non-OAuth popups still silently vanish today, and `browser/` is the one OWNERS namespace with no README (unlike prompt-sessions/scheduler/project-brief/feedback).

**Decision on your "enhance vs. replace" question:** keep Electron's `WebContentsView` — investigation confirmed it's already real Chromium, not a stripped-down engine; there's no open-source-browser-engine dependency to swap in. The actual gaps are narrow: popup-window handling and UA, not the rendering engine. This avoids a much larger, riskier rewrite for no real benefit.

Both PRDs will run headlessly via the scheduler (`when-available` mode) — you can also hit "Run now" in the SchedulePanel. This is a one-shot session so I can't watch them to completion here; check the Scheduler tab or Epic `psess-msareb8c-13` for progress.
were you able to make a decission?

Yes — decision made already, in the previous turn.

**Decision: enhance, don't replace.** Keep Electron's `WebContentsView` as the browser engine. Investigation confirmed it's already real Chromium — there's no open-source browser engine to swap in that would give you more than what's already there. The actual bugs are narrow and fixable:

1. `setWindowOpenHandler` in `src/main/browserView.cjs:191-196` unconditionally denies every popup and fires a dead IPC event nobody listens to — that's why Google's OAuth popup (which needs a real `window.opener` to hand the credential back to) dead-ends at `accounts.google.com/gsi/transform`.
2. No User-Agent is ever set on the view, so it ships as `Electron/x.y.z`, which Google's OAuth endpoint can flag.

Both are queued as PRDs on the "Browser Broken" Epic (`psess-msareb8c-13`):

- **PRD 907** — real child-window popups + Chrome UA for identity-provider domains (Google first, extensible).
- **PRD 908** (depends on 907) — wires the dead `browser:open-tab-request` listener so non-auth popups actually open as a new browser sub-tab, plus writes the missing `session-manager-operations/browser/README.md`.

Nothing further is blocked — that was the full decision and it's already recorded and queued.
